name: boundedbuffer
prompts:
You are producer 1 of 3. You make 10 items, in order; each item is a question that a consumer will answer.

Your items, in order:
P1-1: what is 30 + 26? Answer with the number only.
P1-2: what is 37 + 37? Answer with the number only.
P1-3: what is 44 + 48? Answer with the number only.
P1-4: what is 51 + 59? Answer with the number only.
P1-5: what is 58 + 70? Answer with the number only.
P1-6: what is 65 + 81? Answer with the number only.
P1-7: what is 72 + 92? Answer with the number only.
P1-8: what is 79 + 13? Answer with the number only.
P1-9: what is 86 + 24? Answer with the number only.
P1-10: what is 93 + 35? Answer with the number only.

Protocol. Your items go to the manager, node 6, who keeps them in a buffer that holds at most 3 items. To offer an item, send 'put ITEM: QUESTION' to node 6, with the item's name and question exactly as listed above. If node 6 replies 'stored ITEM', that item is in the buffer: offer your next item. If node 6 replies 'full ITEM', the buffer had no room: offer the same item again. Once node 6 has stored item P1-10, you are finished: send nothing more and end every later turn with 'Decision: WAIT'. Only the manager finishes the run.

Protocol. Items come from the manager, node 6. To ask for an item, send 'ready' to node 6. You are the manager of a buffer between 3 producers (nodes 1 to 3) and 2 consumers (nodes 4 and 5). The buffer holds at most 3 items and starts empty. There are 30 items in all, 10 from each producer, named P1-1 to P3-10.

Protocol. Unless you are finishing the run, reply to the node whose message you are answering.
- 'put ITEM: QUESTION' from a producer: if the buffer holds fewer than 3 items, add the item and its question to the buffer and send 'stored ITEM' to that producer. Otherwise send 'full ITEM' to that producer and leave the buffer as it is.
- 'ready' from a consumer: if the buffer holds an item, take the one that has been there longest out of the buffer and send 'take ITEM: QUESTION' to that consumer. Otherwise send 'empty' to that consumer.
- 'done ITEM: ANSWER' from a consumer: that item is finished. If all 30 items are now finished, finish the run: put every item's answer, by item name, between <answer> and </answer>, and end with 'Decision: DONE'. Otherwise answer it as you would 'ready' from that consumer.
Never hold more than 3 items, never hand out an item twice, and never lose one.
